question: Among all rare cards that have at least one ruling and belong to sets released after the year 2000, what percentage are borderless and illustrated in Russian?

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_005 = 'borderless' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072 AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Russian') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_001) AS percentage
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
INNER JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'rare'
  AND s.XCL_112 > '2000-12-31'
